newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Pivensa looses marginal oil field.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Pivensa looses marginal oil field.

text.p: A Venezuelan consortium that won the Mata field operating contract in Venezuela's third oil auction round in June has been disqualified by state owned oil company PDVSA, El Nacional reported.
Venezuela's Pivensa and PBE Trading Co will lose the right to operate the field in eastern Venezuela due to bidding irregularities, El Nacional reported.

The consortium's successful $90.78 million bid beat out by just three million dollars the second highest bid by Argentina's Perez Companc and Venezuela's Corporacion Corepli in the auction round that saw Venezuela take in over $2 billion from the sale of operating rights to 18 fields.

No decision has yet been taken on the Mata's future operator, the paper said. Options currently under consideration include either re-auctioning the field, which currently produces 600 barrels per day and has proven reserves of 101 million barrels, or selling it to the second highest bidder.
